segments.source: No es cuestión de enamorarse a primera vista, pero sí creemos que es bueno conocer más en profundidad en qué consisten las ofertas de trabajo. Son datos públicos que nos pueden contar aspectos importantísimos tanto de la empresa, como del territorio donde están asentadas. Los requisitos que piden a sus futuros trabajadores y su análisis pueden ayudar tanto a las personas que buscan empleo, como al sector de la educación o a los gobiernos e instituciones de cara a prever situaciones de déficit o superávit en alguno de ellos. En una economía interdependiente y globalizada como la que vivimos, ofrecer un excelente comportamiento del flujo de la mano de obra puede ayudar a asentar empresas, y ser un buen apoyo para la economía y la toma de decisiones.
segments.en: It is not a matter of falling in love at first sight, but we do believe that it is good to know more in depth what job offers consist of. These are public data that can tell us very important aspects of both the company and the territory where they are located. The requirements they ask of their future workers and their analysis can help both job seekers, the education sector, and governments and institutions in predicting situations of deficit or surplus in any of them. In an interdependent and globalized economy like the one we live in, offering excellent labor flow behavior can help establish companies, and be a good support for the economy and decision making.

segments.source: Por este motivo, decidimos acudir a la base, y crear un sistema capaz de interpretar la oferta diaria de puestos de trabajo en la comunidad autónoma de Aragón, e intentar sacar de allí el máximo partido al modelo de ficha con los datos básicos que encontramos en cada uno de los empleos que allí se anuncian. segments.en: For this reason, we decided to go to the base, and create a system capable of interpreting the daily offer of jobs in the autonomous community of Aragón, and try to get the most out of the card model with the basic data that we find in each of the jobs that are advertised there. It must also be taken into account that INAEM manages a good part of the jobs that enter the labor market in Aragon, but not 100%. Therefore, our conclusions cannot in any case be closely adjusted to reality, but rather become trends, approximations and evolutions close to the real job offer.

segments.en: At first glance they look like data tables with a similar pattern and a specific order. But the truth is that in practice it is found that this is not the case. Each office has its own uses and customs, which makes data processing difficult. For example, some write towns with capital letters, and others only the initial is capitalized. This makes it identified as two different populations if we see an offer in BARBASTRO and another in Barbastro, they can also be differentiated by accents (for example, Sabiñánigo and Sabiñanigo) or because they are simply written incorrectly (for example, concinero instead of cook, grú to refer to crane, etc.). There are also duplicate job offers, and as for the characteristics of the global description of the offer, in some offices they detail them as "Requirements" and in others as "Tasks", among other differences. Some offices even do not put labels that separate the different concepts within the description, which prevents the model from being applied.

segments.en: As we have explained, among the problems we have encountered is the different indexing according to each INAEM office. If all of them filled out the same online template with exactly the same criteria, the processing of the data would be much simpler and immediate. What good is data if it is not semi-structured? What if there is no pattern that facilitates the extraction of information? If our approach were also implemented and compiled with this data day by day, it would be a valuable weapon for the management of employment in the community of Aragón, allowing us to know in a timely manner the evolution of the different sectors, of the places where work is offered, of the requirements that companies request for their future employees. A lot of our work has gone into fixing details that shouldn't be there. segments.source: Incorporar otras plataformas de empleo, puesto que la del INAEM no representa toda la oferta existente. Requeriría de un complejo estudio para encontrar en esas otras plataformas el modo de homogeneizar la información, es decir, unificar en un única característica aquellos textos que significan lo mismo pero se categorizan bajo etiquetas diferentes. Esto incluso podría pasar dentro de una misma plataforma, como tenemos en el INAEM.
segments.en: Incorporate other employment platforms, since INAEM's does not represent all the existing offer. It would require a complex study to find on these other platforms a way to homogenize the information, that is, unify into a single characteristic those texts that mean the same but are categorized under different labels. This could even happen within the same platform, as we have at INAEM.
